name: Curiosity
oracle_text:
Enchant creature
Whenever enchanted creature deals damage to an opponent, you may draw a card.
blocked_sentences: Whenever enchanted creature deals damage to an opponent, you may draw a card.

needs.what: a trigger event fired whenever a permanent deals damage of any kind -- combat or noncombat -- to a player, with the damaging permanent as the subject (so an Aura's `filter: {"attached": true}` can scope it to the enchanted creature) and the damaged player available to a `defending` clause so "to an opponent" can be said
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `deals_combat_damage_to_player` is the near miss and is combat-only by construction: `primitives.damage_player` fires EventType.COMBAT_DAMAGE_TO_PLAYER only inside `if is_combat`, so a pinger, a Fireball, a fight or any triggered burn under this Aura draws nothing -- and pingers are precisely what this card is played with, so the substitution is a different card, not a weaker one. `dealt_damage` is the other candidate and is the wrong half of the right event: EventType.DAMAGE_DEALT already carries every damage to a player with `to="player"` and a `combat` flag, but `triggers._matches` explicitly rejects `event.data.get("to") != "permanent"` for it, and its OBJECT_SUBJECT_TRIGGERS entry makes the subject the victim rather than the dealer -- so it can never see damage aimed at a player, and even on the permanent half it would identify the wrong object. `life_lost` reaches the loss but not the dealer: its subject is a player, so nothing ties the loss back to the enchanted creature, and it fires for discards, taxes and Phyrexian mana as readily as for damage while an infect hit deals damage and fires it not at all.
